title: When the Bakery Wakes
author: Juniper Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
